scope: Actual checksum-verified Ubuntu CI download, read-only application outside source tree, fresh verified own-disc import. Native level 3/bike 8 with 14 rivals/road users, audio connected to a private null sink, films off and vsync off. 640x480 classic raster fitted to 960x720 window. Window focus not instrumented. No other native acceptance app, local build or profiler ran during this hour; ordinary user desktop applications were left untouched. Real one-hour two-lap tour: six minutes per course/lap. The predeclared second lap supplies four complete warm-course samples. Canyon reached the fixed telemetry sample cap; its partial values remain published, with a fresh independent 320-second Canyon supplement required. Complete segments cannot be replaced after observing their results. Both laps and the supplement are published.

rows.sample_scope: Independent full-duration supplement; hour sample reached telemetry cap

limitations: This is the lowest tested physical machine, not a proven lower hardware minimum.
No exclusive desktop focus, original Windows runtime parity, other OS/GPU or physical-controller certification claimed.
GPU descriptor bytes exclude swapchains and opaque driver memory; RSS and allocator peak are separate.
Cold/warm file-cache probes do not establish shader-cache hit rates.
Global/framework exit retention is nonzero; see separate Heaptrack receipt.
RSS is sampled once per second and can miss brief transients; allocator peaks are measured separately.
